create_ovis_model: create an Ovis multimodal model instance for vision-language inference with vLLM
build_visual_tokenizer: build a VisualTokenizer that encodes image patches into visual token embeddings
process_image_inputs: process image inputs by parsing pixel values and indicator tokens into multimodal embeddings
run_ovis_forward_pass: run an Ovis forward pass with input IDs, positions, and optional image embeddings
test_ovis_processor: test the OvisMultiModalProcessor for converting prompts with image tokens into model inputs
